questions.stem: A technician prepares a USB drive to transfer 8 GB video files between Windows 11 and macOS computers. Both systems must read and write the files without additional filesystem software. Which format BEST meets these requirements?

choices.explanation: Windows can read and write NTFS, but macOS does not provide normal native NTFS write support. It does not meet the two-system write requirement.

APFS is native to modern macOS. Windows does not natively read and write an APFS volume, so it needs additional software.

questions.explanation: Filesystem compatibility and individual file size are separate requirements. exFAT meets both here. Before reformatting an existing drive, preserve its data because formatting removes the existing filesystem contents.
